result.summary: This is a residential street with continuous sidewalks and mature street trees providing a buffer from traffic. While the environment is generally walkable, the lack of marked crossings and significant sun glare create visibility challenges for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sun Glare
hazards.description: Intense direct sunlight significantly reduces driver visibility of the roadway and potential pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway looking towards the horizon

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and large tree trunks create blind spots where pedestrians, particularly children, may be hidden from drivers' view.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street along the curb line

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and bring pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond parked cars.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk with Signage
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility marked crosswalk with pedestrian crossing signs to formalize crossing points in this long residential block.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming to ensure low vehicle speeds in a residential area where visibility is periodically compromised by glare.

result.summary: This residential street features multi-story row houses and mature street trees that provide shade but also create visual obstructions. While a marked crosswalk is present, the wide roadway and on-street parking may lead to higher vehicle speeds and reduced visibility for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The width of the travel lanes and the overall roadway may encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential context.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the image across the asphalt surface.

interventions.title: Daylighting

interventions.title: Curb Extensions

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane arterial road with sidewalks on both sides and a signalized intersection ahead. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like marked crosswalks and curb ramps are present, the wide crossing distance and lack of physical medians or traffic calming measures create a moderately high-risk environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic at the intersection without a refuge island.

hazards.name: High Speed Environment
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes encourage higher vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade standard crosswalk markings to high-visibility continental patterns.
